confirmed_output_failure.classification: Composition/usable plot allocation gap; draft rendering already emits overlap findings and blocks readiness.

confirmed_output_failure.outcome: Generated stacked plot spans only36.13px/28.12px/16.14px vertically in p-style/midnight-blue/modern-template;19.19pxaxis labels collide. Table is retained.
not_claimed: No silent content truncation after repair
No new template layout name needed
root_pointers: svggen/cartesian_layout.go:59 ComputeCartesianLayout reserves axis and legend space after canvas sizing
svggen/scales.go:182 LinearScale.Ticks count is approximate, not a hard cap
confirmed_output_failure.additional_mechanism: At domain0..60, requested count2 uses span/count=30,nice step20 and emits4ticks[0,20,40,60]. Font-aware count alone therefore does not guarantee label spacing. Minimum useful plot allocation must evaluate the actual axis/legend geometry.
confirmed_output_failure.ordinary_workaround: Increase chart region height, place the table beside the chart, reduce legend overhead, or move supporting table to a separate slide. The tested one-pass allocation remains too short in all three templates.
suggested_acceptance: Before rendering a semantic stacked-chart+table composition, account for axis labels, legends and the actual available plot height.
Produce a noncolliding plot with readable magnitude differences in p-style and tracked templates, while retaining every table row and evidence note.
When the requested shares cannot meet a defined readable plot minimum, provide an actionable alternative allocation/arrangement or separate-slide suggestion; continue truthful readiness blocking.
Test short Q1/Q2/Q3 labels,4series,total50,table2rows and0..60domain; include actual-tick spacing checks rather than nominal tick counts alone.
Keep synthetic quote+stat+action controls legible across same templates.
